cd /private/tmp/lightclaw-diagnosis-live-20261021/slot-host-1/workspace/task && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
src='scratch/tags.json'
raw=open(src,'rb').read()
data=json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8'))
seen=set(); out=[]
for s in data:
    t=s.strip()
    if not t: continue
    if t in seen: continue
    seen.add(t); out.append(t)
with open('scratch/tags-clean.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(out,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(out)
EOF
cat scratch/tags-clean.json; file scratch/tags-clean.json; md5 scratch/tags.json
